messages.author: 6dc5aee7960d0b9d
messages.subject: bcfa error - nonnest2 issue
parts:
Hello! Thanks so much for this wonderful package and the work you all have done.

I am running into a new issue when attempting to fit a second order factor model via bcfa. I have previously (March 2021) fit similar models and they have worked - I noticed this current issue when I attempted to revisit/update an analysis.

Below is the model syntax, the bcfa function call, and the error that I receive. The model will actually go through the full MCMC sampling process and will print off once it is done. This error occurs under a number of conditions, including using inits = "prior", target = "stancond", and test = "none". 

I would greatly appreciate any advice or insight into what might be causing this. For some context, the data (N =1000) do include some missing data (~94 cases, 63 patterns). The model runs totally fine with lavaan::cfa.

# Code begins here

library(rstan)
library(blavaan)
library(tidybayes)
future::plan("multicore")

# Measurement Model

second_order = '
# Latent Constructs

competence =~ intelligent + expert + informed + competent + smart
goodwill =~ not_slfcentered + interests_heart + concerned_wme + sensitive + understanding
trustworthiness =~ honest + trustworthy + honorable + ethical + genuine

credibility =~ competence + goodwill + trustworthiness

belief_rehab =~ belief_tx_1 + belief_tx_2 + belief_tx_3 + belief_tx_4
belief_mh =~ belief_mh_1 + belief_mh_2 + belief_mh_3 + belief_mh_4
'

bmeas = bcfa(model = second_order,
             data = dta,
             std.lv = TRUE,
             inits = "simple",
             sampling.weights = "weight",
             target = "stan",
             n.chains = 4, burnin = 500, sample = 1000,
             cp = "srs",
             dp = dpriors(nu = "normal(0, 2.5)",
                          alpha = "normal(0, 1)",
                          lambda = "normal(0, 1)",
                          beta = "normal(0, 1)",
                          theta = "gamma(1,.5)[sd]",
                          psi = "gamma(1,.5)[sd]",
                          rho = "beta(4, 4)"),
             seed = 333399)

Error in llcont.lavaan(tmpobj) :
  nonnest2 only works for lavaan models fit via ML
  (assuming multivariate normality, with no robust SEs).

Jason
